## `neuro.promise.reject`

Static method on `Promise`.

> Creates a new rejected promise for the provided reason.

## Signatures

```ts
reject(input: { reason?: any; prompt?: string }): Promise<Promise<T>>
```

The `prompt` field is optional. When omitted (or set to an empty string)
the wrapper falls back to the native `Promise.reject` and returns a
resolved Promise without contacting the LLM. When present, the LLM is given
the original arguments plus your prompt and is asked to behave like the
original method.
